errors.evidence: The months on the horizontal axis are ordered chronologically using Roman numerals (I to XII), not alphabetically.

errors.text_span: Най-ниските са в месец VIII за 2022, със стойност около 80,000.
errors.evidence: The lowest value for 2022 is not in month VIII but in month VII, as shown in the chart.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates percentage values for three years across the months of the year.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the highest value is in December 2022, exceeding 120,000, nor does it highlight the lowest value for 2023 (80,000 in December and July).
The machine-generated description does not mention that 2024 generally has the highest values across the months.
